gallery.description:
An aerial view of a pentagon fort on an island.
Fort Sumter and Fort Moultrie National Historical Park is located in South Carolina and was added to the Network in 2019. This site interprets Civil War and Reconstruction era Charleston, including the story of Robert Smalls, early emancipation celebrations in the city, as well as Freedman activities at the close of the Civil War.
